quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #7
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: If you need to slow down on a slippery road, what should you do first?
questions.explanation: First, release the gas pedal to slow down on a slippery road. If you need to slow more, gently press the brake pedal with steady, light pressure.

questions.question: When turning onto a street with multiple lanes going your direction, which lane should you turn into?

options.text: The lane closest to the lane you were just in.
The lane marked with an arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to the lane you were just in.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane closest to your previous lane. Do not change lanes while turning.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spot before changing lanes?

options.text: Look in the left side mirror.
Look in the right side mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move to check your blind spot.

questions.question: Why should you use extra caution when driving near a pedestrian with a white cane?
questions.explanation: A white cane or guide dog means the person is blind. Slow down, yield, and be ready to stop to keep them safe.

questions.question: What causes many crashes?

options.text: Drivers going too fast for the conditions.
Drivers checking mirrors and blind spots regularly.
Drivers keeping a four-second following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers going too fast for the conditions.
questions.explanation: Many crashes happen because drivers go too fast for the conditions. Always follow speed limits and slow down when conditions are not ideal.

questions.question: Where should you keep a space cushion around your vehicle?

options.text: Only on the left and right sides.
Only in front of your vehicle.

questions.explanation: Keep space on all sides of your vehicle so you have time to react to hazards. Do not get too close to vehicles on your left or right.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When slow driving disrupts the normal flow of traffic.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: When slow driving disrupts the normal flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: Driving too slowly and disrupting traffic flow is illegal. You can get a ticket for it.

questions.question: How should you safely pass a bicycle?

options.text: Honk at the bicyclist to warn them.
Drive in the bicycle lane to get around them.
Slow down and give them plenty of space.
Speed ahead and cut in front of them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and give them plenty of space.
questions.explanation: Slow down and give bicyclists as much space as possible. Bicyclists are not protected like cars are. Passing too fast can knock them off course.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means parking is not allowed here.

questions.question: Which of these does not help with safe night driving?

options.text: Know that tinted windows reduce visibility at night.
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle.
Stare into the headlights of oncoming cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stare into the headlights of oncoming cars.
questions.explanation: Looking at oncoming headlights makes your pupils shrink. After the car passes, your eyes need time to adjust back to the dark. During this time, you cannot see well.

questions.question: When turning left from a multilane, one-way street or highway, which lane should you start from?
questions.explanation: Always start a left turn from the left lane on multilane streets and highways.

questions.question: You are in a line of traffic crossing railroad tracks with no signals or gates. What should you do?

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You may pass slower drivers while crossing the track.
Make sure your vehicle has enough space to cross the tracks completely without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your vehicle has enough space to cross the tracks completely without stopping.
questions.explanation: Before driving onto railroad tracks, check that you have enough room to cross completely without stopping. Never try to pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing. Always look for trains before crossing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces that are reserved only for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What is the speed limit for driving your vehicle?

options.text: A speed that is reasonable and safe.
A speed that is safe for current conditions.

questions.explanation: You must follow the legal speed limit and drive at a speed that is reasonable, safe, and appropriate for the area, traffic, pedestrians, weather, road condition, and light.

questions.question: Which traffic signal gives you the right-of-way to turn left?
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go in that direction. Oncoming traffic must stop, so you have the right-of-way to turn left.

questions.question: A vehicle just parked on the side of the road ahead of you. What should you do as you pass?

options.text: Assume the driver will open the car door as you approach.
Assume the driver will wait for you to pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Assume the driver will open the car door as you approach.
questions.explanation: Expect that a parked car's driver may open the door as you pass. Drive carefully around parked vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or respond to cross traffic.

questions.question: What do work zone signs mean?

options.text: You must immediately stop and back up.
You should drive faster to get out of the work zone.

questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange and warn that work is being done on or near the road. Drive very carefully in these areas.

questions.question: What do large flashing arrow panels mean?

options.text: Drivers may stay in their current lane.
There is something to look at in the direction of the arrow.
Drivers should merge into the lane indicated by the arrow.
Drivers should come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers should merge into the lane indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: Large flashing arrows are used in construction areas when a lane is closed. Slow down and merge into the lane the arrow points to.

questions.question: What happens to your field of vision when you increase your speed?

options.text: It makes it easier to see cross traffic.

questions.explanation: The faster you drive, the narrower your field of vision becomes. As speed increases, you must watch more carefully for hazards.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does a reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle mean?
questions.explanation: An orange reflective triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves at 25 mph or slower. You may see this on farm equipment, construction vehicles, and horse-drawn wagons.

questions.question: You are driving in the right lane of a multilane highway and want to move left. What should you do?

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for traffic behind you.
Look over your left shoulder to check your blind spot.
Check your side mirror and turn on your signal.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and look over your shoulder to make sure no vehicles are in your way. Always signal before you change lanes.

questions.question: Your wheels slip off the edge of the road. What should you do?

options.text: Jerk the steering wheel to force the vehicle back onto the pavement.
Speed up and gradually steer back onto the pavement.
Slam on your brakes and stop.
Gently apply the brakes to slow down. Then steer back onto the pavement at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gently apply the brakes to slow down. Then steer back onto the pavement at a safe speed.
questions.explanation: If your wheels leave the road, gently apply the brakes to slow down while keeping the wheels off the pavement. Once you are at a safe speed, steer back onto the road. Do not sharply turn the wheel.

questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing with a crossbuck sign but no gates or flashing lights. What should you do?

options.text: Approach with caution and cross only when you are sure no train is coming.
Lower the volume on your radio so you can hear a train.
Wait for a flagger to clear you before crossing.

questions.explanation: Always approach railroad crossings with caution and cross only when you are sure no train is coming from either direction. If a flagger is present, follow their instructions.
